title: Adaptive Radiotherapy for Patients With GBM
official: ART-GBM: Feasibility Study of Adaptive Radiotherapy (ART) for Patients With Glioblastoma (GBM)
summary: This is a single institution single arm feasibility study of MRI-guided, personalized adaptive radiation therapy with reduced margins for patients with glioblastoma.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histologically confirmed IDH-wildtype glioblastoma (WHO Grade 4)
* Age ≥ 18 years
* Karnofsky Performance Status ≥ 60
* Planned 30 or 15 fractions of radiation therapy with or without concurrent systemic therapy
* Ability to undergo MRI imaging with IV gadolinium contrast
* Ability to provide written informed consent
* Multifocal tumors permitted if clinician anticipates they will be encompassed in a single radiation plan

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior intracranial radiotherapy
* Multicentric disease
* Leptomeningeal dissemination
* Pregnancy
sponsor: Abramson Cancer Center at Penn Medicine
